protocol.pose: saved stand; all non-selected-limb and passive joints fixed
protocol.clearance: minimum exact support of every floor-compatible collision geom in the foot subtree
protocol.fore_aft: collision-pad center projected onto frozen trunk +X
protocol.sensitivity_grid: 9 equally spaced normalized targets from -0.8 to +0.8; INVENTED diagnostic grid, not biological parameters
protocol.parameter_probes: INVENTED bounded diagnostic targets only, not controller changes: hind multipliers -1/-2; front press -0.4/-0.2/0 plus continuous swing delta -0.8/-1.2, current/zero tuck. Explicit ctrl clipping is reported.

limitations: Command targets are not achieved dynamic poses. Static overlap is not measured contact force.
Margin, soft contacts, torque/velocity limits, passive-joint response, body motion and servo lag are not simulated.
Feedback modes are conditional branches; actual rollout switches with measured front load.
A continuous periodic trajectory has equal-and-opposite net stance/swing return displacement; contact release, timing and path shape can differ.
